description: The shared synthetic session case set (Hub #1865, design decision 10). Each case is an input sequence and checks. Steps are at `atMs` after `startAtMs`: an observation (`observe`), a transport repeat of an earlier step (`again`), a different message under an earlier step's message ID (`conflict`), a consumer's notice acknowledgment, a clock advance, a core restart, the one-time cutover reset, or launch-only roots that fill the session limit (`fill`). A check holds, after `after` steps and at `atMs`, the expected copy as session/3.0 records, the removals, the occurrences since the previous check in publication order, and each reader's expected output. Records name sessions, turns and notices by name, give the work state with why running work is unconfirmed besides its evidence (`unconfirmed`: `restart`) and children as `[working, unconfirmed]`, and take their status from their claims; and the loader in src/v2/session-cases.ts expands them into messages the core families accept. Revisions and generations count steps: the core compares their order, not their values. `since` names the first step of #1865 whose core produces the case: `now` is today's core, `step 7` the storage step and `step 8` the restart, root-start and capacity step. Hub #1947 removed the five-minute work deadline: silence never changes a claim. Reader outputs follow design decision 10 and hold for the shared read function from step 1, with status rule 3 as `noticeCounts` defines it: a notice counts until a known later turn supersedes it (owner decision, 2026-11-18). Native assistant tasks (Hub #505) are observed by their one producer in lifecycle/2.2 with known ordering, and their records are session/3.1; a notice may carry its task's `result`. Everything here is synthetic.

cases.name: launch without a prompt stays quiet
cases.covers: design decision 6 (#397): a start creates an unknown root idle, with no work turn

cases.name: resume and clear without a prompt stay quiet
cases.covers: design decision 6 (#397): a start keeps a known root's work and turn, and /clear's new session starts idle

cases.name: mid-turn compaction keeps the active turn
cases.covers: design decision 6 (#397): a start on a known root keeps its running turn

cases.name: an approval raised and resolved
cases.covers: design decision 3: attention needs the owner; a tool result resolves the turn's approval

cases.name: a question silent for more than five minutes
cases.covers: design decision 4 as Hub #1947 amends it: silence changes no claim, so the session is not republished and the question keeps its meaning

cases.name: working silent for more than five minutes
cases.covers: design decision 4 as Hub #1947 amends it: silence never makes running work unconfirmed, and the session is not republished

cases.name: a restart with a question, an outcome and running work
cases.covers: design decision 4: a restart makes only running work unconfirmed and publishes no occurrence

cases.name: a stale delayed start cannot replace a newer turn
cases.covers: design decisions 6 and 8: a start for a retired turn is stale

cases.name: parent and child updates
cases.covers: design decisions 3 and 6: a child start is child work, and a child counts as working only while its own work is confirmed

cases.name: a root that works only through its child
cases.covers: design decisions 3 and 10: a working child makes its idle root working until the child's own work is unconfirmed, here by a restart (Hub #1947), and then the root's finished turn shows on every device, Nanoleaf included

cases.name: transport duplicates, semantic duplicates and a collision
cases.covers: design decision 8: a repeat is a duplicate, other content under the same message ID a conflict, and a native event ID with new content ambiguous ordering

cases.name: out-of-order evidence
cases.covers: design decision 8: an observation behind its dimension's watermark is stale

cases.name: ambiguous ordering leaves the status unknown
cases.covers: design decision 3: unknown work with no other claim is unknown, detailed by the activity's reason

cases.name: the session limit with roots of two sources
cases.covers: design decision 7: a new root displaces one finished child subtree; a new child, or a root with nothing to displace, is refused

cases.name: 24-hour expiry
cases.covers: design decision 4: a session is removed as expired 24 hours after its last lifecycle evidence

cases.name: a runtime end retires the session tree
cases.covers: design decision 5: session-ended comes before the tree's removals, and a later child event is stale

cases.name: per-consumer acknowledgment and read evidence
cases.covers: design decision 3: acknowledgments stay per consumer, and each reader's policy retires finished

cases.name: a status detail the reader does not know
cases.covers: design decisions 3 and 10: an unknown detail falls back to its class and never makes an action eligible

cases.name: a finished turn whose next prompt start was lost (S1)
cases.covers: PR 1903 review R1: hooks publish once and fail open, so a Stop for p2 can arrive without its UserPromptSubmit; the turn becomes ambiguous and both notices stay unacknowledged

cases.name: a stop without a turn ID after a known running turn (S2)
cases.covers: PR 1903 review R1: missing turn evidence never hides the recorded outcome

cases.name: a notice with an unknown turn, then a next turn that starts and is interrupted (S3)
cases.covers: PR 1903 review R1: only a known later turn supersedes a notice

cases.name: a finished turn superseded by a known next turn that is interrupted
cases.covers: design decision 3, rule 3: a notice that a known later turn superseded makes no finished status

cases.name: lost activity evidence on running work
cases.covers: design decision 3: ambiguous or lost activity evidence makes active work unconfirmed (PR 1903 review R3)

cases.name: a copy that has not synced
cases.covers: design decision 10: an unsynced copy marks every Tronbyt row and Pixoo row, and LIFX shows unknown

cases.name: the cutover reset
cases.covers: design decisions 9 and 12: the reset publishes nothing, the next sync serves no session, and a session that returns has a new generation

cases.name: a native task asks, is answered, resumes in a new run and succeeds
cases.covers: Hub #505 decisions 3 and 4: a task is a root, a run a turn and a clarification blocking input; the answer resolves only its question; a result names the finished detail

cases.name: native tasks fail, are cancelled while waiting for approval, are paused and are left uncertain
cases.covers: Hub #505 decision 4 and owner decision 1: a failure stays unread, an owner cancel ends the task with its notice acknowledged for every consumer and clears its approval, a paused task makes no running-work claim, and an uncertain one is unknown

cases.name: duplicate and late native observations revive nothing
cases.covers: Hub #505 decision 7: known ordering makes a late raise or a late stop of an earlier run stale, and a transport repeat is a duplicate

cases.name: a restart with a running and a waiting native task
cases.covers: Hub #505 decision 7: a restart makes the running task's work unconfirmed and keeps the waiting task's question; the engine's recovery then reports the task paused

cases.name: a native task waits past a day, expires, and reappears when answered
cases.covers: Hub #505 decision 8: expiry removes the monitoring record only, and the task's next change creates a new session with a new generation
